parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The storeview name used for fuzzy match.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The offset of the returned results in the total list of storeviews. Default value: 0.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The number of storeviews to return. Default value: 100.

parameters.name: storeType
parameters.description: The storeview type. By default, results are not filtered by type.
